Samir: Quick non-work poll: who's for a 'not-so-ugly' sweater day? Optional, but someone promised a tiny crown for the most festive. :crown:
Ivy: I'm in. Also making peppermint biscotti to share.
Tara: Remote, but will wear a ridiculous holiday tie on camera.
Jon: I'll rock the sweater. If someone brings a tiny mistletoe I'll volunteer as official mistletoe-hanger. :laughing:
meme-bot: *drops GIF of a corgi in a sweater*
Samir: OK show-and-tell Friday 11am in #random. We'll do a 5-min parade for anyone who wants to pop by camera. Recording optional.
Ivy: If anyone wants my biscotti recipe just ping me.
Tara: Vote: in-person parade time 11a or 3p? React :one: for 11a, :two: for 3p.
Jon: :one: preferred
Samir: Looks like 11a wins. I'll bring the tiny crown. See you then!
